recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, warm-toned portrait of a smiling man in a denim jacket against a dark, out-of-focus natural background, framed by bold, outlined bubble lettering at the top and high-contrast serif typography in the center.
coreVisualRelationships: The large, outlined title at the top creates a header frame for the subject's head.
The central yellow text acts as a horizontal anchor across the subject's chest.
The dark, bokeh background pushes the warm-lit subject forward for maximum depth.
coreInvariants: Soft, diffused outdoor lighting on the face
Heavy black outlines on the primary display text
A color palette dominated by deep greens, blues, and warm flesh tones

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot, centered, with the subject leaning forward slightly to fill the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and smile, positioned at the vertical center-line.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large top title, moves down to the face, then to the central yellow title, and finally to the supporting tracklist text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, textured foliage in the upper corners provides space for secondary text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep forest green and navy blue (background and clothing)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm peach and golden yellow (typography and skin highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright text/face and the low-value, desaturated background.

letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses ultra-bold, rounded 'bubble' forms with tight kerning and thick outlines.
Secondary title uses a heavy, high-contrast serif with rounded terminals.
Body text uses a clean, bold sans-serif.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Interlocking or overlapping characters in the main title
Thick, contrasting stroke weights in the central serif text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bubble display for impact paired with a classic high-contrast serif for sophistication.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the rounded, heavy, vintage feel of the era.
Captures the high-contrast serif look for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A medium shot of a smiling Black man with a short afro and mustache, wearing a blue denim jacket, outdoors. The background is a dark, out-of-focus forest at dusk. Warm, soft lighting on his face.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, peach-colored bubble-style title with a thick black outline at the top. Add a golden-yellow bold serif title across the center. Place two columns of small white sans-serif text in the upper left and right corners.

verificationChecks: Is the top text heavily outlined?
Is the background dark and blurry?
Is the central text golden yellow?
Does the subject have a warm, friendly expression?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the bubble font feels 'puffy' and vintage.
Verify the denim texture is visible.
Confirm the lighting feels like golden hour or soft daylight.
recipe.reuseFormula: Vintage Soul Portrait = (Centered Warm Portrait + Dark Bokeh Background) * (Bubble Display Header + High-Contrast Serif Anchor)
